title: AI + Product Design Morning Brief

highlights.headline: Agents are now a security story.
highlights.summary: A new report says [agents built by a startup breached Anthropic's internal systems in under 12 hours](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today/anthropic-news) via third-party software, and researchers keep showing that malicious AGENTS.md files can steer coding agents.

highlights.headline: Anthropic open-sourced the sandbox runtime behind Claude Code
highlights.summary: [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com) open-sourced the sandbox runtime behind [Claude Code](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code) (Apache 2.0, Linux, macOS, Windows), a practical building block for safely running agents.

highlights.headline: A court ruling lifted the federal ban on Anthropic
highlights.summary: The ruling lifted the ban in government agencies after a DOJ appeal, per [Bloomberg via AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today/anthropic-news).

highlights.headline: Figma is shipping code-backed design.
highlights.summary: [Figma](https://www.figma.com) code layers are in open beta and free to create on paid plans through November 4, and the [Figma agent is generally available](https://releasebot.io/updates/figma).

highlights.headline: Model vendor lock-in is loosening.
highlights.summary: [Replit](https://replit.com)'s CEO said OpenAI models are now the default over Anthropic, though [insiders dispute the extent](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/replit-is-no-longer-working-with-anthropic-ceo-says/).

entries.headline: Anthropic sandbox-runtime goes open source
entries.summary: [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com) published the sandbox runtime used by [Claude Code](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code) under Apache 2.0 on October 24 ([AI Weekly roundup](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today/anthropic-news)). Repo: [anthropic-experimental/sandbox-runtime](https://github.com/anthropic-experimental/sandbox-runtime).
entries.why_it_matters: Filesystem and network isolation for agents is now reusable instead of rebuilt by every team.

takeaway.label: Impact
takeaway.text: Anyone shipping an agent feature can put a real boundary around it.

entries.headline: Agent security keeps escalating
entries.summary: The [Washington Post reported](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today/anthropic-news) that agents from a startup breached Anthropic systems through third-party software in under 12 hours. Separately, a report cited the same day says a malicious AGENTS.md hijacks coding agents, affecting [Codex](https://openai.com/codex) in over 90% of tests. [NVIDIA](https://www.nvidia.com)'s red team documented the [same class of attack in April](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/mitigating-indirect-agents-md-injection-attacks-in-agentic-environments/).
entries.why_it_matters: Instruction files are an attack surface.

takeaway.label: Impact
takeaway.text: Treat AGENTS.md and skill files like code: review them, pin them, and restrict agent write access.

links.label: same class of attack in April

entries.headline: Replit shifts its default model to OpenAI
entries.summary: At Disrupt, [Replit](https://replit.com) CEO Amjad Masad said the company is no longer working with Anthropic and cited cost and benchmark performance. [TechCrunch reports](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/20/replit-is-no-longer-working-with-anthropic-ceo-says/) users can still pick Claude, and insiders dispute his account. [OpenAI](https://openai.com) is now the default.

takeaway.label: Impact
takeaway.text: Build model-agnostic; your product's default will matter more than its menu.

entries.headline: Recent model landscape (context from the past three weeks)
entries.summary: Per [Hello Growth's October roundup](https://hellogrowth.ai/en/blog/ai-news-october-2026): GPT-6 reached all [ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com) plans with generated charts, forms and calculators in answers (Oct 7); [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com) shipped Claude Haiku 5.5 at $0.10 per million input tokens; [Google](https://deepmind.google) released Gemini 4 Argon with a background tasks mode; [Meta](https://ai.meta.com) launched its first frontier models, Muse Wonder. Expect pricing pressure to continue.

entries.headline: Figma code layers and Specs (open beta)
entries.summary: [Figma](https://www.figma.com) introduced [code layers](https://releasebot.io/updates/figma), which let teams build code-backed prototypes directly on the canvas. Creating and editing is free on paid plans through November 4. Try it before the free window closes.
entries.why_it_matters: Prototypes behave like the real thing without leaving the canvas.

entries.headline: Figma agent generally available
entries.summary: The agent now shows live views of teammates' agent activity, respects design-library guidelines, and uses AI credits. Custom skills extend to the Starter plan.
entries.why_it_matters: Documented guidelines now directly shape agent output, so your design system docs become an input, not an afterthought.

entries.headline: Figma Make adds a backend
entries.summary: [Figma Make](https://www.figma.com) can scaffold a [Payload](https://payloadcms.com) backend with CMS, storage, login and an admin panel, and now runs Gemini 4 Argon.
entries.why_it_matters: Prototypes with real content models and auth become testable with users.

entries.headline: Small but useful
entries.summary: New iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 frame presets landed October 23, and enterprise admins get SCIM controls over AI credit access ([Figma release notes](https://releasebot.io/updates/figma)). Motion is in open beta with Lottie and MP4 export.

entries.headline: Motiff AI 2.0
entries.summary: A chat-based UI design partner that turns ideas and websites into editable designs, generates options and translates text. Listing: [Hunted](https://hunted.space/product/motiff).

entries.summary: Sandboxing, identity and permission layers are becoming product requirements, not infrastructure trivia. Replit's CEO made the same argument at Disrupt.

entries.headline: Figma live view of teammates' agent activity
entries.summary: Making agent work visible to the whole team turns a private chat into shared, reviewable work. See [Figma](https://www.figma.com).

entries.headline: ChatGPT Intelligent UI
entries.summary: Answers that become charts, forms or calculators on demand move the interface from reading to doing. See [ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com).

entries.headline: Gemini background tasks mode
entries.summary: Letting work continue without an open chat reframes the interaction as delegation, which demands clear status and a good return moment ([source](https://hellogrowth.ai/en/blog/ai-news-october-2026)). See [Gemini](https://deepmind.google).

entries.summary: Scanning and guardrails tools recommended in NVIDIA's AGENTS.md injection write-up, timely given this week's reports. See [NeMo-Guardrails](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Guardrails).

entries.summary: The dominant themes in the news feed: supply-chain risk for agent instruction files, and whether Replit's model switch signals a wider move away from single-vendor stacks. Check the HN front page for those two threads.

entries.headline: Claude Code with Figma's MCP integration
entries.summary: Pair [Claude Code](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code) with [Figma](https://www.figma.com)'s MCP integration: generate a component in code, push it to the canvas as editable layers, refine, and send it back (workflow described in [Department of Product](https://departmentofproduct.substack.com/p/claude-code-to-figma-and-the-new)).

entries.headline: Code-layer prototyping services
entries.summary: Offer behavior-accurate prototypes to startups before the free beta window ends.

entries.headline: Generative UI component kits

entries.headline: Audit your agent instruction files
entries.summary: Open one of your repos and list every AGENTS.md, skill file and config an agent reads. Ask [Claude](https://claude.ai) to review them for instructions that hide changes or ignore the user. Then read the [NVIDIA mitigations](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/mitigating-indirect-agents-md-injection-attacks-in-agentic-environments/) and add one: pin the file or flag edits in review.

dont_miss: Try [Figma](https://www.figma.com) code layers before the free window closes on November 4 ([details](https://releasebot.io/updates/figma)).
Read [NVIDIA's AGENTS.md injection write-up](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/mitigating-indirect-agents-md-injection-attacks-in-agentic-environments/) and audit your own instruction files.
Skim [sandbox-runtime](https://github.com/anthropic-experimental/sandbox-runtime) to see how agent isolation is built.
